description: This file defines a class 'NodeCapabilityRouter' responsible for routing commands to their corresponding handlers within a node. It includes error handling, a typealias for handler functions, and a method to process requests asynchronously.

classes.name: NodeCapabilityRouter
classes.description: A class that manages routing of command requests to appropriate handlers based on command identifiers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the router with a dictionary of handlers.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a request asynchronously, invoking the corresponding handler or throwing an error if none is found.
